mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_station_dual_write_task(receipt_id,idempotency_key,request_fingerprint,api_version, payload_ciphertext,payload_nonce,payload_tag,key_id) VALUES(#{receiptId},#{idempotencyKey},#{requestFingerprint},#{apiVersion},#{payloadCiphertext},#{payloadNonce}, #{payloadTag},#{keyId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=LAST_INSERT_ID(id)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_station_dual_write_task WHERE overall_status IN ('ACCEPTED','PROCESSING','PARTIAL','RETRY_PENDING') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at<=NOW(3)) AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at<NOW(3)) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE t_station_dual_write_task SET overall_status='PROCESSING',lease_owner=#{leaseOwner}, lease_expires_at=DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL 30 SECOND),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at<NOW(3))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_station_dual_write_task WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{leaseOwner}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_station_dual_write_task SET new_platform_status='SUCCEEDED',overall_status='COMPLETED', feedback_source_id=#{sourceId},lease_owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,next_retry_at=NULL, completed_at=NOW(3),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{leaseOwner} AND old_fbp_status='SUCCEEDED'

UPDATE t_station_dual_write_task SET overall_status=#{overallStatus},retry_count=#{retryCount}, old_fbp_status=CASE WHEN old_fbp_status<>'SUCCEEDED' THEN #{failedStatus} ELSE old_fbp_status END, new_platform_status=CASE WHEN old_fbp_status='SUCCEEDED' AND new_platform_status<>'SUCCEEDED' THEN #{failedStatus} ELSE new_platform_status END, next_retry_at=CASE WHEN #{finalFailure}=FALSE THEN TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{delaySeconds},NOW(3)) ELSE NULL END, lease_owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,last_error_code=#{errorCode},last_error_summary=#{errorSummary},updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{leaseOwner}
